in_marathi.name: Mayursinh
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lord of the Mountain, Sun God
in_marathi.long_meaning: Mayursinh हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Mayursinh is a compound name composed of 'Mayur' (peacock) and 'Sinh' (lion). 'Mayur' represents the sun, beauty, and power. 'Sinh' represents courage, strength, and the king of the jungle. Thus, Mayursinh is the lord of the mountain and the Sun God.
